title: Sambar
description: A lentil-and-vegetable stew simmered with tamarind and sambar powder — the everyday South Indian accompaniment to idli, dosa and rice.

ingredients.name: Tamarind
ingredients.notes: a lemon-sized ball, soaked and pulp extracted

ingredients.name: Drumstick
ingredients.notes: cut into 2-inch pieces, or substitute with pumpkin/carrot

steps: Pressure cook the toor dal with turmeric and water for 4-5 whistles, until soft. Mash lightly and set aside.
In a pot, simmer the tamarind pulp with the drumstick, shallots and tomato for 10-12 minutes until the vegetables are nearly tender.
Add the sambar powder and salt, and simmer for another 5 minutes.
Add the cooked dal and enough water to reach the desired consistency. Simmer for 10 minutes so the flavours combine.
For the tempering, heat oil in a small pan. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the dried red chilli, curry leaves and asafoetida, letting them sizzle for 20-30 seconds.
Pour the tempering over the sambar and garnish with coriander leaves. Serve hot with idli, dosa or rice.
